method.source_scale: One source pixel is one raw unit per family; no per-view/frame bbox scaling. Optional working512 transform uses ONE front-derived scale per family and translates measured body ground pivot to [256,480].
method.prop_rule: Rigid props/hand ownership use precise source masks. Preserve original alpha; broad prop rectangles below are measured diagnostic bounds, not shipping masks.
method.knee_rule: Null hidden knee is intentional. Source-pixel deformation cannot supply unseen thigh/knee/prop paint.
method.source_closed: All nine visible sources show closed crease/ink, no source cavity or teeth. source_upper==source_lower==crease deliberately; teeth=0. No fabricated source teeth bar.
method.sheet_isolation: Diagnostic raw crops include generous own fringe. Fink rear/left alpha<4 residues overlap and a raw rectangular crop may include a thin neighbour strip. Isolate the measured own silhouette with its source-aligned matte before encoding; preserve all own painted support and original alpha. Do not use nominal columns or silently alter sources.
